coupling: The first commit sizes the shared sliding window at its documented minimum rather than twice that minimum. Lossless decoding still has its calculated history and copy headroom. The later alpha-window commit passes one row of history, relying on the earlier doubling to cover a 24-row final macroblock batch plus the preceding row. Either edit alone leaves at least 25 alpha rows; together they allocate 24 for the probe image, so alpha extraction writes beyond the allocated plane. The fix must reconcile the shared sizing rule with the alpha caller's batch requirement.
